info.title: OpenSwissData — public read-only API
info.description: Read-only JSON endpoints over the official localities and streets directories (swisstopo), the combined commune profile, the Swiss company fiche (company_check) and the public source registry. Free, no key, limited per network address. The same data is also available over MCP (see /mcp) without a key. Unofficial copies: binding decisions belong to the official sources named in each `sources` entry.

get.description: Same fiche as the MCP tool `company_check`: commercial register data (LINDAS), FINMA register entries and LEI records (GLEIF), each fact with its source and, when known, the date it was read, plus exact cross-checks between sources and checks of the registered address against the official localities and streets directories. A `sources` array (id, publishing institution, licence, URL) is added next to the fiche. No score, no verdict. Does not say whether the company is still registered, and does not cover FOSC publications, SECO sanctions or officers.

400.description: Invalid UID (bad format or invalid check digit)

429.description: Rate limit exceeded for this network address (60 requests/hour)

get.description: Rows of the official swisstopo directory of localities (postal code, locality, municipality, canton), exactly one of the two query parameters required.

200.description: Matching rows, directory edition and source

400.description: Neither or both query parameters given

503.description: Directory not currently available on this service

429.description: Rate limit exceeded for this network address (600 requests/hour, shared with /communes and /sources)

get.description: Name, canton, postal codes and localities (official localities directory), number of official streets (official streets directory) and FINMA-authorised entities exactly attached to this commune (same city and canton, matching a single commune — see `finma.matching`), each with its sources and directory editions. `finma.national_matching` gives the same rattachement counted nationally (matched/unmatched/ambiguous, numbers only) — most FINMA rows currently have no known canton, so a commune's own count reads against this national total. No score, no ranking between communes.

404.description: Commune not found in any loaded directory

429.description: Rate limit exceeded for this network address (600 requests/hour, shared with /localities and /sources)

get.summary: Public registry of sources served by the API and the MCP server
get.description: Id, publishing institution, licence and URL of each public source, with the directory edition or data version when known. The TARES permission reference is never shown here (it names a person): TARES entries carry `licence: "see the provenance file of the archive"` instead.

429.description: Rate limit exceeded for this network address (600 requests/hour, shared with /localities and /communes)
